layouts.name: Dunsfold without Runway
layouts.description: Draft configuration: Complete independently mapped airfield perimeter follows the Western rounded return, Northern service straight, Eastern outer straight and Southern inward bend. The developer identifies the retained peri-track as a five-kilometre loop. The exact 4857.6 m OSM source route excludes the central runway, Northern business-park roads and inner Top Gear corner loops. Fine corner alignment, direction and timing extent remain draft; the catalogue scalar is 4782 m. Branch identity was checked against catalogue layout facts and circuit identification references. Independent source distance 4857.6 m; no coordinates are changed to match a diagram or distance. Travel direction and historical alignment remain provisional.
